items.body_raw: וְהַמַּיִם גָּבְרוּ מְאֹד מְאֹד עַל־הָאָרֶץ וַיִּגְוַע כָּל־בָּשָׂר הָרֹמֵשׂ עַל־הָאָרֶץ בָּעוֹף וּבַבְּהֵמָה וְכֹל הָאָדָם
items.answer_raw: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth, and all flesh expired that moved upon the earth, among birds and cattle, and all mankind.

items.body_raw: וְהָיָה כָעָם כַּכֹּהֵן וּפָקַדְתִּי עָלָיו מַעֲלָלָיו וְאָכְלוּ וְלֹא יִשְׂבָּעוּ כִּי אֶת־יהוה עָזָבוּ
items.answer_raw: And it shall be, like people, like priest, and I will visit his deeds upon him; and they shall eat, and not be satisfied, for Yahweh they have forsaken.

items.body_raw: וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ וַיִּקְרְאוּ אֶת־יָרָבְעָם וַיַּמְלִיכוּ אֹתוֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל
items.answer_raw: And they sent and called Jeroboam, and they made him king over Israel.

items.body_raw: And all the people bowed-down upon their knees before their king.
items.answer_raw: וַיִּכְרַע כָּל־הָעָם עַל־בִּרְכָּיו לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ

items.body_raw: חֲזַק וֶאֱמָץ כִּי אַתָּה תַּנְחִיל אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לַאֲבוֹתָם לָתֵת לָהֶם
items.answer_raw: Be strong and of a good courage, for thou shalt cause this people to inherit the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.

items.body_raw: שְׁלָחַנִי יהוה לַחֲבֹשׁ לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי־לֵב
items.answer_raw: Yahweh sent me to bind up the broken-hearted.

items.body_raw: גַּע בֶּהָרִים וְיֶעֱשָׁנוּ
items.answer_raw: Touch the mountains, that they may smoke.

items.body_raw: Let me cross the river, that I may make this people inherit the land which Yahweh sware unto their fathers to give them.
items.answer_raw: אֶעְבְּרָה־נָּא אֶת־הַנָּהָר וְאַנְחִילָה אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהוָה לַאֲבוֹתָם לָתֵת לָהֶם

items.body_raw: יֻקַּח־נָא מְעַט מַיִם וְרַחֲצוּ רַגְלֵיכֶם וְהִשָּׁעֲנוּ תַּחַת הָעֵץ וְאֶקְחָה פַת־לֶחֶם וְסַעֲדוּ לִבְּכֶם אַחַר תַּעֲבֹרוּ
items.answer_raw: Let there now be fetched a little water, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree, and let me fetch a morsel of bread, and sustain ye your hearts: afterwards ye shall pass on.

items.body_raw: אֶשְׁמַע
items.answer_raw: I will hear

items.body_raw: אֶשְׁמְעָה
items.answer_raw: Let me hear, or I would (fain) hear (cf. Ps. 85:9)

items.body_raw: בְּהִשָּׁמַע
items.answer_raw: When it was heard (cstr. inf. Niph.)

items.body_raw: תַּשְׁמַע
items.answer_raw: Cause to hear (jussive Hiph., proper after אַל; not 'thou shalt cause to hear', which would be תַּשְׁמִיעַ)

items.body_raw: שֹׁלַחֲךָ
items.answer_raw: He (or one) who sends thee (ptc. Qal)

items.body_raw: שְׁלֹחַ
items.answer_raw: To send (inf. cstr.)

items.body_raw: שְׁלַח
items.answer_raw: Send thou (imper. masc.)

items.body_raw: שִׁלַּחֲךָ
items.answer_raw: He sent thee (m.) away (Pi.; not simply 'he sent thee', which would be Qal שְׁלָחֲךָ)

items.body_raw: אֶשְׁלָחֲךָ
items.answer_raw: I will send thee (m.)

items.body_raw: יִשְׁכָּחֵהוּ
items.answer_raw: He will forget him

items.body_raw: שָׁכַחַתְּ
items.answer_raw: Thou (f.) hast forgotten

items.body_raw: נִשְׁכַּחַת
items.answer_raw: Thou (f.) that hast been forgotten (a difficult form; see the key's note on Isa. 23:15)

items.body_raw: הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי שֹׁלֵחַ מַלְאָךְ לְפָנֶיךָ לִשְׁמָרְךָ בַּדָּרֶךְ הִשָּׁמֶר מִפָּנָיו וּשְׁמַע בְּקֹלוֹ
items.answer_raw: Behold, I am sending an angel before thee to keep thee in the way: take thou heed before him and hearken unto his voice.

items.body_raw: אֶבְיוֹנֵי צִיּוֹן אַשְׂבִּיעַ לֶחֶם וְכֹהֲנֶיהָ אַלְבִּישׁ יֶשַׁע
items.answer_raw: The poor of Zion I will satisfy with bread, and her priests I will clothe with salvation.

items.body_raw: וַיִּטַּע יהוה גַּן בְּעֵדֶן וַיַּצְמַח מִן־הָאֲדָמָה כָּל־עֵץ נֶחְמָד לְמַרְאֶה וְטוֹב לְמַאֲכָל
items.answer_raw: And Yahweh planted a garden in Eden, and he made to grow out of the ground every kind of tree, desirable in appearance and good for food.

items.body_raw: וַיִּקַּח יַעֲקֹב אֶת־נָשָׁיו וְאֶת־יְלָדָיו וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת־מַעֲבַר יַבֹּק וַיִּקָּחֵם וַיַּעֲבִרֵם אֶת־הַנַּחַל וַיַּעֲבֵר אֶת־אֲשֶׁר לוֹ וַיֵּאָבֵק אִישׁ עִם יַעֲקֹב וַיֹּאמֶר הָאִישׁ שַׁלְּחֵנִי כִּי עָלָה הַשָּׁחַר וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אֲשַׁלֵּחֲךָ כִּי אִם בֵּרַכְתָּנִי וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הַמַּלְאָךְ לֹא יֵאָמֵר עוֹד יַעֲקֹב שִׁמְךָ כִּי אִם יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתוֹ שָׁם וַיִּזְרַח לוֹ הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָבַר אֶת־פְּנוּאֵל וְהוּא צֹלֵעַ עַל־יְרֵכוֹ
items.answer_raw: And Jacob took his wives and his children and crossed the ford of the Jabbok; and he took them and sent them across the stream, and he sent across what he had. And there wrestled a man with Jacob; and the man said, Let me go, for the dawn has risen. And he said, I will not let thee go, unless thou bless me. And the angel said to him, Thy name shall no more be called Jacob, but Israel; and he blessed him there. And the sun rose upon him as he passed over Penu'el, and he was limping upon his thigh.

items.body_raw: השמיעני בבקר חסדך כי־בך בטחתי
items.answer_raw: Make me to hear thy kindness in the morning, for in thee do I trust.

items.body_raw: This song shall never be forgotten.
items.answer_raw: לֹא תִשָּׁכַח הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת לְעוֹלָם

items.body_raw: In the day of his being anointed (Niph.)
items.answer_raw: בְּיוֹם הִמָּשַׁח אֹתוֹ

items.body_raw: Yahweh will give you in the evening flesh to eat, and bread in the morning to be satisfied (inf. Qal).
items.answer_raw: יִתֵּן יְהוָה לָכֶם בָּעֶרֶב בָּשָׂר לֶאֱכֹל וְלֶחֶם בַּבֹּקֶר לִשְׂבֹּעַ

items.body_raw: He caused thee to hear his words out of the fire.
items.answer_raw: הִשְׁמִיעֲךָ אֶת־דְּבָרָיו מִתּוֹךְ הָאֵשׁ

items.body_raw: Ye shall surely hearken to the voice of my messenger, when I send him to you.
items.answer_raw: שָׁמוֹעַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ בְּקוֹל מַלְאָכִי בְּשָׁלְחִי אֹתוֹ אֲלֵיכֶם

items.body_raw: And Samuel said, Speak, Yahweh, for thy servant is listening (ptc.).
items.answer_raw: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל דַּבֵּר יְהוָה כִּי שֹׁמֵעַ עַבְדֶּךָ

items.body_raw: And he fought against the city all that day, and he took the city, and the people that (was) in it he slew, and he pulled down the city and sowed it with salt (acc.).
items.answer_raw: וַיִּלָּחֶם עַל־הָעִיר כָּל־הַיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־הָעִיר וְאֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר בָּהּ הָרָג וַיִּתֹּץ אֶת־הָעִיר וַיִּזְרָעֶהָ מֶלַח

items.body_raw: And one said to the other, Let the two of us swear in the name of our God; so they sware, the two of them.
items.answer_raw: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל־אָחִיו נִשָּׁבְעָה שְׁנֵינוּ בְּשֵׁם אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַיִּשָּׁבְעוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם

items.body_raw: Whither shall I flee from thy presence?
items.answer_raw: אָנָה אֶבְרַח מִפָּנֶיךָ
